questions.question: Two articles are sold for Rs. 4880 each, on one article the seller gained 22% and on the other he lost 20%. What is his overall gain or loss percentage, nearest to one decimal place?
questions.solution:
Correct Answer **3.4% loss**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

SP of each article = Rs. 4,880

CP of first article = 4,880 × [100/122] = 4,000

CP of second article = 4,880 × [100/80] = 6,100

Total SP of both article = 4,880 × 2 = 9,760

Total CP of both article = 4,000 + 6,100 = 10100

Total loss = 10,100 - 9,760 = 340

Loss percentage = [340/10100] × 100 = 3.36% ≈ 3.4%

questions.question: The price of sugar is increased by 24%. A person wants to increase his expenditure by 15% only. By what percentage, correct to one decimal place, should he reduce his consumption?
questions.solution:
Let initial price of sugar be 100x

Price of sugar after increased = 100x × [124/100] = 124x

Person wants his expenditure increase by 15% only,

So his expenditure should be = 100x × [115/100] = 115x

Required percentage = [(124 - 115x)/124] × 100 = 7.25% ≈ 7.3%

questions.question: In a circle of radius 13 cm, a chord is at a distance of 5 cm from its centre. What is the length of chord?
questions.solution:
Let AB is chord and point M is the midpoint of AB, O is the centre

Given, OB = 5 cm and OB = 13 cm

In ΔOMB

Using Pythagoras theorem

⇒ (OB)² = (OM)² + (MB)²

⇒ 13² = 5² + (MB)²

⇒ MB = √(169 - 25) = 12

As we know, AB = 2 MB

AB = 2 × 12 = 24 cm

questions.question: Find the value of 7.5 + (5.4 ÷ 4.5 × 2) - 8 × 4 ÷ 3.2
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below∶

Step-1∶ Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and in the bracket,

Step-2∶ Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3∶ Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4∶ Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated. 

⇒ 7.5 + (5.4 ÷ 4.5 × 2) - 8 × 4 ÷ 3.2

⇒ 7.5 + (6/5 × 2) - 8 × (1/0.8)

⇒ 7.5 + 2.4 - 10

⇒ 9.9 - 10

⇒ -0.1

questions.question: Which is the ratio of the production of rice in all three states in the year 2014 to that in 2016?
questions.solution:
Total production of rice of all three states in 2014 = 6.2 + 4.8 + 6.4 = 17.4

Total production of rice of all three states in 2016 = 6.9 + 5.7 + 7.4 = 20

Required ratio = 17.4 ∶ 20 = 87 ∶ 100

questions.question: If the total production in three states in all six years is represented by a pie-chart, what is the central angle of the sector representing production in the year 2014. (to nearest whole number)?
questions.solution:
Total production of rice of state A over the years = 5.2 + 5.4 + 5.8 + 6.2 + 6.5 + 6.9 = 36 million tonnes

Total production of rice of state B over the years = 3.8 + 4.1 + 4.4 + 4.8 + 5.2 + 5.7 = 28 million tonnes

Total production of rice of state C over the years = 4.5 + 5.2 + 5.8 + 6.4 + 6.7 + 7.4 = 36 million tonnes

Total production of rice of three states in all six years = 36 + 28 + 36 = 100 million tonnes

Total production of rice of three states in 2014 = 6.2 + 4.8 + 6.4 = 17.4 million tonnes

100 million tonnes represents = 360°

17.4 million tonnes will represents = [360/100] × 17.4 = 62.64° ≈ 63°

questions.question: In a class of 60 students, 40% are girls. The average weight of the whole class is 59.2 kg and the average weight of the girls is 55 kg. What is the average weight of the boys?
questions.solution:
Total students in the class = 60

Average weight of class = 59.2 kg

Sum of weight of all class = 59.2 × 60 = 3,552

Number of girls in class = 60 × 40/100 = 24

Number of boys in class = 60 - 24 = 36

Average weight of girls is = 55

Sum of weight of girls is = 55 × 24 = 1320

Sum of weight of boys is = 3,552 - 1320 = 2232

Average weight of boys = 2232/36 = 62 kg

questions.question: Walking at 3/4 of his usual speed, a person reaches his office 18 minutes late than the usual time. His usual time in minutes is∶
questions.solution:
**Concept Used:**

As we know,

Time is inversely proportional to speed.

**Calculation:**

Let the usual speed of the person be 4x

And, Speed of the person after decreasing = 3x

Ratio of usual speed to after decreasing = 4x ∶ 3x

Ratio of usual time to after decreasing = 3x ∶ 4x

Now, 4x - 3x = 18

⇒ x = 18

3x = 18 × 3 = 54 min

questions.question: The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio of 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 5. Working together, they can complete a task in 6 days. In how many days will A alone complete 20% of that task?
questions.solution:
The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio of 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 5

Total work = (2 + 3 + 5) × 6 = 60

20% of the total work = 60 × 20/100 = 12

20% of the total work completed by A in = 12/2 = 6

questions.question: In ΔABC, P is a point on BC such that BP ∶ PC = 3 ∶ 4 and Q is the midpoint of BP. Then ar(ΔABQ) ∶ ar(ΔABC) is equal to∶
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd013bb813b86dcef1ce3876b50518b97b619dae7fa64fe800cd70763ba684.png] 

Given, BP ∶ PC = 3 ∶ 4

Suppose BP = 3 unit and PC = 4 unit

BC = BP + PC = 3 + 4 = 7 unit

If Q is the midpoint of BP, then BQ = QP

BQ = BP/2 = 3/2 = 1.5 unit

ar ΔABQ ∶ ar ΔABC = BQ ∶ BC

ar ΔABQ ∶ ar ΔABC = 1.5 ∶ 7 = 3 ∶ 14

questions.question:
In a circle with centre O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 132° at the center of the circle. Chord AB is produced to point P. Then ∠CBP is equal to∶

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28832360e59a672649f31a756f665b37f31d4d202803524132ff3c46220d8567.png]
questions.solution:
As we know

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28832360e59a672649f31a756f665b37f31d4d202803524132ff3c46220d8567.png] 

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle is double the size of the angle subtended by the same arc at the circle circumference

Take any point Q on the circumference and join AQ and QC.

∴ ∠AOC = 2 × ∠AQC

⇒ ∠AQC = 1/2 × ∠AOC = 1/2 × 132° = 66°

Now, ∠CBP = ∠AQC [Exterior angle of cyclic quadrilateral]

⇒ ∠CBP = 66°

questions.question: What is the value of x so that the seven digit number 6913x08 is divisible by 88?
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 8 ⇒ A number divisible by 8 if its last three digit is divisible by 8.

Divisibility law of 11∶ If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 - 3 + 4 - 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

⇒ 6913x08 divisible by 8 if x = 0 or 8

questions.question: ΔABC ∼ ΔRQP and PQ = 10 cm, QR = 12 cm and RP = 18 cm. If ar(ΔABC) ∶ ar(ΔPQR) = 4/9, then AB is equal to∶
questions.solution:
⇒ Given ΔABC ~ ΔRQP,

⇒ PQ = 10 cm, QR = 12 cm, RP = 18 cm and ar(ΔABC) ∶ ar(ΔPQR) = 4/9,

As we know,

⇒ ar(ΔABC)/ar(ΔPQR) = (AB/RQ)²

⇒ AB²/12² = 4/9

⇒ AB² = 12² × 4/9

⇒ AB = 12 × 2/3 = 8 cm
